messages:
ana: Quick design spike question 12. Thinking about compact badges in the run inspector to surface structured output keys (like status, id, summary) so you can scan runs without expanding the full JSON.
sam: Nice. Are badges derived from the function response schema or heuristics on the payload?
ana: Plan A = schema-driven (preferred). Plan B = fallback heuristics (first string <100 chars, numeric ids).
matt: We should allow product teams to configure which schema paths become badges. Maybe a small gear icon on the run header to pick fields.
julie: Config is powerful but could add cognitive load. Default to 3 fields: primary, id, and a timestamp if present. Expose config in the run inspector settings panel.
ridhi: a11y: badges must have aria-labels ("status: succeeded") and be reachable via keyboard. Also ensure contrast meets AA for small text.
diego: Copy features: copy JSON, copy as Python dataclass, copy as TS type. Python dataclass seems useful for backend teams. Can we add it?
sam: Add 'Copy as Python dataclass' behind an ellipsis menu. Keep primary actions (copy JSON, open in editor) as visible buttons.
matt: UX nit: label the editor action "Open in function editor (jump to response schema)" so it's crystal clear.
julie: Performance note: for large runs (>20KB), show a placeholder badge "Large response" and add an action "Open in inspector" rather than parsing top-level keys client-side.
ridhi: keyboard flow: tab into run header, press Enter to open quick actions, arrows to select badge actions, Escape to collapse. We'll need focus traps avoided.
ana: telemetry: track events for badge clicks (run.preview.badge_click) and config changes (run.preview.config_save). Need to confirm with analytics before finalizing names.
diego: visual approach idea: inline badge color = intent (green/yellow/red) derived from schema enum if provided. If not, gray.
matt: accessibility reminder: don't rely on color alone. include icons and text.
ajulia: (typo correction) -> julie: Also consider a mode toggle: per-run badges vs global compact view (single-pane list with badges). Some users will want a denser compact mode.
sam: Implementation acceptance criteria: 1) schema-backed badges for common types; 2) config accessible from run header; 3) keyboard & screenreader flows documented; 4) perf fallback for >20KB payloads.
ana: I'll prototype two visual directions (icons-first compact vs text-first readable badges) and include keyboard-only screenshots. Posting later today.
playground-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://playground-staging.redwood.ai/?feature=run-badges 12. Branch: feature/run-badges. Reactions: :eyes: 4 :thumbsup: 2.
